title: Writing an Empty Interval
statement: Let $\mu,f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$ and $d\in\mathbb{N}$. Writing zero values of $f$ into $\mu$ starting at $d$ leaves $\mu$ unchanged.
replaced:
Let $\mu,f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$ and $d\in\mathbb{N}$. Replacing the values of $\mu$
on the empty interval $d\le a<d$ with values from $f$ leaves $\mu$ unchanged.
